paragraphs: Rabbi Chanina of Beit Chavran, or from Chavran. See the entry Rabbi Chanina.

notes.text: The alternatives “of Beit Chavran” and “from Chavran” are retained. The frozen target is Chanina; an older machine reading Chunya has not been adjudicated from a scan here.

The saved named Guggenheimer Sheviit 6:1 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Chunya of Berat Chavran. This is a relevant comparison for the older Chunya reading, not proof of the frozen Chanina wording or its pointer. Both supplied place alternatives remain, without a geographical identification.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. II, p. 497) reads Chanina in both the heading and the cross-reference. A separately headed notice (vol. I, pp. 413–414) discusses Chunya of Berat Chavran and variant forms of his name. Yerushalmi Sheviit 6:1 and Beitzah 3:2 attest Chunya or Chunyah of Berat Chavran. These parallels leave the destination of the brief “Rabbi Chanina” cross-reference unspecified.
